title: Compatible Koszul comparisons on a chosen regular cover
statement: Let i:Z→Y be a closed immersion, V an open, n a natural number and assume Koszul-regular affine generators near V. Write B=i_*O_Z, G=H^n(RHom_Y(B[0],B[0])), T=(i*G)|V and F=dual(exteriorSheaf(i*ker(i),n))|V. There exists a family W_z of neighborhoods containing z and isomorphisms c_z:F.over W_z ≅ T.over W_z whose hom components agree on each common subopen. This statement only produces one cover; it does not extend comparisons to prescribed larger neighborhoods.

proof.text: Use the nested-chart comparison family. For each z in V choose a regular affine chart A(z) from hregular and set W(z)=V⁻¹(i⁻¹A(z)). Chart membership gives z in W(z), and the family supplies the local isomorphism.

Fix two selected charts and a common subopen U. At each z of U, refine the first chart inside the second using koszulRegularImmersion_affine_refinement. Intersect its inverse image in V with U. These intersections cover U pointwise. Both selected comparisons agree with the refined comparison by nested-chart naturality. For a section over U, naturality identifies restriction of the two images with applying the local comparisons to its restriction. Their equality on the intersections and TopCat.Sheaf.eq_of_locally_eq give equality of the images on U. Extensionality gives the required equality of component morphisms.

theorem koszulRegularImmersion_self_ext_conormal_compatible_cover
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace))]
    [IsClosedImmersion i] (V : Z.Opens) (n : ℕ)
    (hregular : ∀ z : Z, z ∈ V → ∃ U : Y.affineOpens, i z ∈ U.1 ∧
      ∃ (m : ℕ) (f : Fin m → Γ(Y, U.1)),
        Ideal.span (Set.range f) = i.ker.ideal U ∧
          RingTheory.Sequence.IsKoszulRegular f) :
    let B := (Scheme.Modules.pushforward i).obj (SheafOfModules.unit Z.ringCatSheaf)
    let S := DerivedCategory.singleFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) 0
    let H := derivedInternalHom (Opens.grothendieckTopology Y) Y.toRingedSpace.sheaf
    let G := (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Y.toRingedSpace)) (n : ℤ)).obj
        (H.obj (op (S.obj B), S.obj B))
    let T := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj G)
    let F := (Scheme.Modules.restrictFunctor V.ι).obj
      (Scheme.Modules.dual (Scheme.Modules.exteriorSheaf
        ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback i).obj i.ker.toModules) n))
    ∃ (W : V.toScheme → V.toScheme.Opens),
      (∀ z : V.toScheme, z ∈ W z) ∧
      ∃ c : ∀ z : V.toScheme, F.over (W z) ≅ T.over (W z),
        ∀ (x y : V.toScheme) (U : V.toScheme.Opens)
          (hx : U ≤ W x) (hy : U ≤ W y),
          (c x).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hx))) =
            (c y).hom.val.app (op (Over.mk (homOfLE hy)))
